verdict.rationale: Rev AI's own docs describe a Streaming Speech-to-Text API used over the WebSocket protocol (or RTMP). Clients send binary WebSocket audio messages and receive hypotheses of recognized speech as it is detected, which is real-time transcription. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of streaming behavior and latency, and evidence of endpoint URL, message-format or final-vs-partial hypothesis details.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream live audio over a documented WebSocket or streaming endpoint and receive transcription in real time

citations.quote: the client can start sending binary WebSocket messages containing audio data... As speech is detected, Rev AI returns hypotheses of the recognized speech content.
There are two ways to interact with the Streaming Speech-to-Text API: WebSocket protocol, RTMP streams
